[[File:Bacta_tourniquet.jpg|250px|thumb|A bacta tourniquet]]
A '''bacta tourniquet''' was a medical device attached to a severely damaged or severed limb to heal the wound.<ref name="POTJ">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Power of the Jedi|pack=Leia Organa (Bespin Escape)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/potjleiabespinescp.asp}}</ref> Princess [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] used one of these devices to treat [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] wound on the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] after the loss of his hand during his [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|duel]] with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].<ref name="EP5">{{Film|V}}</ref>
